subject: [video] WP04 correction: the word cfg was eaten by shell quoting in my last post
body: In the speed-mode post the sentence should read: 'the next lever is to gate on cfg (n2avc_config) -- e.g. refine only when a switch file is absent, or run the half stage only at 1080p -- but that needs either a config field or a file read in the encoder, both outside my files.' No other change; the numbers and the commit (5835abd) stand.
